design_philosophy.name: Corporate Clarity
design_philosophy.description: A sober, professional aesthetic that prioritizes data legibility and trust. High contrast, rigid grids, and a 'Navy & White' palette that evokes established financial/HR institutions.

typography.installation_instructions: Import fonts from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Public+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');

usage_rules.headings: Use Manrope for all headings (h1-h4). Weight: 600 or 700. Tracking: -0.02em.
usage_rules.body: Use Public Sans for all interface text. Weight: 400 for body, 500 for labels. Leading: relaxed.
usage_rules.numbers: Use tabular-nums class for all data tables and metrics to ensure alignment.

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Primary (Corporate Standard). Dark Mode is secondary.

usage.primary: Used for Sidebar background, Primary Buttons, and Headings in Light Mode. This is the 'Navy Blue'.
usage.secondary: Used for backgrounds of secondary actions and muted sections.
usage.background: Light gray/blue tint (Slate 50) to differentiate from pure white cards.

layout.structure: Sidebar Navigation (Left) + Top Header + Main Content Area.
layout.grid_system: Bento Grid for Dashboard. 12-column grid system.

buttons.style: Sharp corners or slightly rounded (rounded-md). No pill shapes.

cards.style: bg-card text-card-foreground border shadow-sm rounded-lg. Minimalist.
cards.hover: No lift effect. Keep it stable and professional.

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-0 rounded-md

sidebar.style: Fixed width (250px). Dark Navy background (bg-slate-900) with White text. Active item: bg-slate-800 text-white.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, diffuse shadows. shadow-sm or shadow-md. Avoid large, colored shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders in Slate-200. Crisp definition.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers if needed (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).

login_background.description: Modern bright corporate office meeting room. Use with a dark overlay (bg-slate-900/50) for text readability.

user_placeholder.description: Default user avatar if no image provided.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Update index.css to import Manrope and Public Sans. Remove old font imports.
2. UPDATE TAILWIND: Configure tailwind.config.js to use the CSS variables defined in 'colors'. Ensure 'darkMode' is set to 'class'.
3. CSS VARIABLES: Replace the contents of index.css :root and .dark with the variables provided in this JSON.
4. LAYOUT: Create a 'DashboardLayout' component that includes the Sidebar and Header. Wrap all protected routes in this layout.
5. LOGIN PAGE: Use a Split Layout. Left side: Login Form (White bg). Right side: Image (login_background) with a quote or branding.
6. SHADCN: Use existing shadcn components but style them according to the 'Executive Navy' theme (square/rounded-md, not rounded-full).
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items).
8. CHARTS: Use Recharts with the 'Executive Navy' palette (Navy, Slate, Blue-Gray).
9. EXPENSES: This is a priority feature. Make the 'Upload Receipt' button prominent in the UI.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
